messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #91: "[P3][feature] Add SDK versioning and compatibility checks"

## Issue Details
No mechanism exists to detect SDK version mismatches at runtime. If channel-sdk evolves (adding required methods, changing signatures), channel plugins built against older versions silently break.

Currently, the only protection is TypeScript compilation — but channels can pin SDK versions and diverge.

### Blocked by
- #81 (needs ChannelError standardized first)

### Fix
1. Export SDK_VERSION constant from @omni/channel-sdk
2. Add sdkVersion field to ChannelPlugin interface (set during BaseChannelPlugin construction)
3. Add compatibility check in ChannelRegistry during plugin registration
4. Define compatibility rules (semver major = breaking, minor = compatible)

### Acceptance Criteria
- SDK_VERSION exported from channel-sdk
- Compatibility check during registration
- Clear error message on mismatch
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
